dialogue_texts: Kaguya
Koakuma was no help. I guess I'll have to find someone else who can answer that question.
Who are you looking for?
Kaguya
I am looking for Flandre, who may be responsible for this mess.
Kaguya
You look like you might have some answers.
The Scarlet Devil isn't looking to speak with anyone at the moment.
More importantly, I'm looking for the one who assassinated my husband nine months ago.
Kaguya
This brings back painful memories when Vladrouge turned me into a siren.
Kaguya
King Kourin was the only one who could break that curse and make me humanoid again.
Kaguya
Speaking of which, are you his wife?
Camille
Correct. I am his wife and the mother of Remilia and Flandre Scarlet.
Camille
My grunts are hoping to bring vengeance over the love of my life.
Kaguya
Your defiance is noted, and I'm not leaving until I have answers.
Camille
I think that if you're who I think you are, I won't tell you where Flandre is. She is not in the mansion right now.
Kaguya
Not here? Where has she gone?
Camille
I'm afraid I can't tell you.
Kaguya
Hmph. We have made each other talk over her whereabouts.
Camille
You speak of my daughters as if they are mere subjects to be managed.
Camille
Perhaps you've forgotten your place, My Majesty.
Kaguya
If she's not missing, explain the glohm that chokes the very air Fusana breathed in.
Camille
Then let me see if your skills match your arrogance.
Camille
If you want the truth, you'll have to earn it.
